summary: Backend-only test pass for Scuola Infanzia API. 26/26 pytest tests passed covering auth (login admin/parent, wrong password, /me, forgot+reset, brute-force lockout 5->429), dashboard, school-years CRUD+activate, classrooms (with student_count enrichment, students-by-classroom), students CRUD, enrollment transfer (within same year), year-transition wizard (verified moved count + new-year enrollments), parent invite flow (create -> pending status -> mock_invite_link -> setup-password -> active login -> linked children), resend-invite, activities upsert idempotency + filtering by classroom+year+date_from, menus list/create + current-week match, news list (parent + admin) + create, parent-facing /parent/me/children with classroom enrichment, /child/{sid}/day (today's seeded activity for Alice), /child/{sid}/timeline, 403 for unlinked child, AI daily report returns non-empty Italian text (covers AI path or Italian fallback), role protection (parent->/dashboard/stats=403, parent->DELETE /school-years=403). All assertions covered status codes AND response bodies/persistence.

minor.issue: When a pending parent has no password_hash and is queried with an arbitrary password the server returns 401 (wrong creds) before reaching the 'status==pending' 403 branch. The 403 'account non attivato' message is only reachable if the user already has a valid password_hash but status is still pending. Functionally fine, just note that the spec line 'Parent login fails while status=pending (403)' is technically observed as 401 in this implementation.

Upsert uses filter {student_id, school_year_id:to_year_id} and $set includes a new 'id' field on every call, so re-running the same transition rewrites the enrollment id. Not breaking but non-idempotent on id. Also, the same student is counted as 'moved' even if it was already enrolled.

Filter uses {$or:[classroom_id:X, classroom_id:None]} but seeded global news has classroom_id=None which only matches when classroom_id query param is provided; without classroom_id all news are returned (works as intended). Just confirm desired behavior.

action_items: (Optional) Make pending-parent login return 403 explicitly even when no password set (currently returns 401 because hash is None).
(Optional) In /api/year-transition, avoid overwriting existing enrollment id on each run (use $setOnInsert for id/created_at).
(Code quality) server.py is ~1160 lines; consider splitting into auth.py / school.py / parents.py / activities.py / ai.py modules.

(Security) CORS uses allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — cookies set on /auth/login are therefore unusable cross-origin; Bearer tokens are the only working auth path, which the frontend should use consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py 1159 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline; should be split into modules.
AI report endpoint imports emergentintegrations inside the function — fine for cold-start tolerance but means import errors only surface at runtime.
verify_password swallows all exceptions returning False — could mask malformed hashes silently.
Brute-force counter resets to 0 after lockout creation; if a 6th attempt arrives after 15 min the counter restarts at 1 — acceptable.
No rate limiting on /auth/forgot-password — potential abuse vector (low priority for MVP).
AI daily report fallback uses a hard-coded sentence even when GPT call succeeds with empty text; consider validating response length before caching.
